```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
source("R/disease_list.R")

df <- read_disease_list(params$list_file)

# Preserve the order groups first appear in the file.
df[["disease_type"]] <- factor(df[["disease_type"]],
                               levels = unique(df[["disease_type"]]))

yn <- function(v) ifelse(toupper(trimws(v)) == "X", "Yes", "")

set_flextable_defaults(font.family = "Calibri", font.size = 9, padding = 3)
```

This document is generated automatically from
`r basename(params$list_file)`. Do not edit it by hand - edit the source CSV and
re-render.

It lists **`r nrow(df)`** conditions across **`r nlevels(df[["disease_type"]])`**
groups: **`r sum(toupper(trimws(df[["tobacco-related"]])) == "X")`** tobacco-related
and **`r sum(toupper(trimws(df[["alcohol-related"]])) == "X")`** alcohol-related.

```{r groups, results='asis'}
for (g in levels(df[["disease_type"]])) {
  sub <- df[df[["disease_type"]] == g, , drop = FALSE]
  cat("\n\n#", g, "\n\n")

  tbl <- data.frame(
    Disease        = sub[["Disease category name"]],
    `ICD-10 codes` = sub[["ICD-10 codes"]],
    Tobacco        = yn(sub[["tobacco-related"]]),
    Alcohol        = yn(sub[["alcohol-related"]]),
    check.names    = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  ft <- flextable(tbl)
  ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
  ft <- bold(ft, part = "header")
  ft <- align(ft, j = c("Tobacco", "Alcohol"), align = "center", part = "all")
  ft <- valign(ft, valign = "top", part = "body")
  ft <- width(ft, j = "Disease", width = 2.4)
  ft <- width(ft, j = "ICD-10 codes", width = 3.0)
  ft <- width(ft, j = c("Tobacco", "Alcohol"), width = 0.7)
  ft <- fontsize(ft, size = 9, part = "all")
  flextable_to_rmd(ft)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

# Notes on ICD-10 coding

- Codes are written without the decimal point (e.g. `F502` = F50.2).
- A three-character code covers the whole block (e.g. `C50` = C50.0-C50.9).
- An `(excluding XXX)` clause carves codes out of a category.
- An `X` suffix (e.g. `K85X`) denotes the source data's unspecified
  fourth-character convention.

```{r overlaps, results='asis', eval=params$show_overlaps}
ov <- find_overlaps(df)
cat("\n\n# Data quality check\n\n")
if (nrow(ov) == 0) {
  cat("No overlapping ICD-10 codes were detected between conditions.\n")
} else {
  cat("The following conditions share ICD-10 codes",
      "(a record could be counted under either):\n\n")
  oft <- flextable(ov)
  oft <- set_header_labels(oft,
    disease_a = "Condition A", disease_b = "Condition B",
    shared_codes = "Shared codes")
  oft <- theme_booktabs(oft)
  oft <- bold(oft, part = "header")
  oft <- width(oft, j = c("disease_a","disease_b"), width = 2.4)
  oft <- width(oft, j = "shared_codes", width = 1.5)
  flextable_to_rmd(oft)
}
```
